auncel.definition:
n. A rude balance for weighing, and a kind of weight, formerly
   used in England.

aune.definition:
n. A French cloth measure, of different parts of the country (at
   Paris, 0.95 of an English ell); -- now superseded by the meter.
aune.translation: 昂(古尺： ①法国单位=46.79英寸 ②比利时和瑞士使用的单位=47.24英寸)
